name: BD Canonical Pricing and Valuation Reconciliation
description: Reconcile our lot-level position valuations against Black Diamond silver allocations (the day-over-day source of truth for account-level AUA). Net gap is $68.2M (+4.3%) — $1.661B lot MV vs $1.593B BD AUA — but the gross picture is worse: $211M overcounting across 2,574 accounts offset by $143M undercounting across 3,778 accounts. Root causes span stale lots (BNP Paribas $20.8M in an account BD values at $1.9M), ghost accounts (transferred out, BD zeroed AUA but lots still open), cash double-counting, and pricing divergence across the board. Goal: identify every systematic driver of the gap and build a programmatic reconciliation that aligns our model to BD silver allocations. Not a classification problem — the class mix is similar across over/undershooting accounts (~68-70% equity both sides).
